import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst, cap;
        long cost;
        Edge rev;
        Edge(int s, int d, int c, long co, Edge r) {
            src = s; dst = d; cap = c; cost = co; rev = d;
        }
    }

    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        long dist;
        int node;
        Pair(long d, int n) { dist = d; node = n; }
        public int compareTo(Pair o) {
            if (dist != o.dist) return Long.compare(dist, o.dist);
            return Integer.compare(node, o.node);
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        int n;
        List<List<Edge>> adj;
        int[] supp;
        long[] ptnl;
        long minCost, totalCost;

        MinCostFlow(int _n) {
            n = _n;
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            supp = new int[n];
            ptnl = new long[n];
            minCost = 0;
            totalCost = 0;
        }

        int size() { return n; }

        void addEdge(int src, int dst, int cap, long cost) {
            if (cap <= 0) return;
            if (cost < 0) {
                supp[src] -= cap;
                supp[dst] += cap;
                minCost += cap * cost;
                totalCost -= cap * cost;
                Edge e1 = new Edge(dst, src, cap, -cost, null);
                Edge e2 = new Edge(src, dst, 0, cost, null);
                e1.rev = e2;
                e2.rev = e1;
                adj.get(dst).add(e1);
                adj.get(src).add(e2);
            } else {
                totalCost += cap * cost;
                Edge e1 = new Edge(src, dst, cap, cost, null);
                Edge e2 = new Edge(dst, src, 0, -cost, null);
                e1.rev = e2;
                e2.rev = e1;
                adj.get(src).add(e1);
                adj.get(dst).add(e2);
            }
        }

        void supply(int node, int vol) { supp[node] += vol; }

        boolean flow() {
            long infty = totalCost + 1;
            boolean aug = true;
            while (aug) {
                aug = false;
                Edge[] last = new Edge[n];
                long[] dist = new long[n];
                Arrays.fill(dist, infty);
                TreeSet<Pair> pq = new TreeSet<>();
                for (int node = 0; node < n; node++) {
                    if (supp[node] > 0) {
                        dist[node] = 0;
                        pq.add(new Pair(0, node));
                    }
                }
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    Pair p = pq.pollFirst();
                    int node = p.node;
                    long d = p.dist;
                    if (d != dist[node]) continue;
                    ptnl[node] -= d;
                    if (ptnl[node] > infty) ptnl[node] = infty;
                    dist[node] = infty;
                    for (Edge e : adj.get(node)) {
                        if (e.cap == 0) continue;
                        long nd = ptnl[node] + e.cost - ptnl[e.dst];
                        if (nd < dist[e.dst]) {
                            pq.remove(new Pair(dist[e.dst], e.dst));
                            dist[e.dst] = nd;
                            last[e.dst] = e;
                            pq.add(new Pair(nd, e.dst));
                        }
                    }
                }
                boolean[] shut = new boolean[n];
                for (int dst = 0; dst < n; dst++) {
                    if (supp[dst] < 0 && last[dst] != null) {
                        int resid = -supp[dst];
                        int src = dst, block = n;
                        while (last[src] != null && !shut[src]) {
                            if (resid >= last[src].cap) resid = last[block = src].cap;
                            src = last[src].src;
                        }
                        if (shut[src]) block = src;
                        else {
                            if (resid >= supp[src]) {
                                resid = supp[src];
                                block = src;
                            }
                            for (int node = dst; node != src; node = last[node].src) {
                                last[node].cap -= resid;
                                last[node].rev.cap += resid;
                            }
                            supp[src] -= resid;
                            supp[dst] += resid;
                            minCost += ptnl[dst] * resid;
                            aug = true;
                        }
                        if (block != n) {
                            for (int node = dst; node != block; node = last[node].src) shut[node] = true;
                            shut[block] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int s : supp) if (s > 0) return false;
            return true;
        }

        long optimal() { return flow() ? minCost : -1; }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        final int tlim = 105;
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(6100);
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int j = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            j--;
            mcf.supply(j, 1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            u--; v--;
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                    mcf.addEdge(u, nv, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                    mcf.addEdge(v, nu, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                mcf.addEdge(n * t + i, n * (t + 1) + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        int dst = mcf.size() - 1;
        mcf.supply(dst, -k);
        for (int t = 0; t <= tlim; t++) {
            mcf.addEdge(t * n, dst, k, 0);
        }
        System.out.println(mcf.optimal());
    }
}
